item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #VISPRSD
Issued at 04:31 PM 14 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Leyte(Calubian, SanIsidro, Tabango, Villaba, Mayorga, Macarthur, LaPaz, Javier, Abuyog) and #SouthernLeyte(Silago) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Biliran(Cabucgayan, Biliran, Naval, Almeria) and #Leyte(Leyte) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
